title: FBI Photo B021
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.image_type: grayscale video surveillance or targeting frame with crosshair overlay
pages.description: A grainy grayscale image displaying a gray noisy background with a white crosshair reticle centered in the frame. The reticle has horizontal and vertical scales marked with tick marks and numeric labels reading 15, 10, 5 on both sides of center. A thick black bar occupies the top portion of the image. Several rectangular black bars (apparently redaction or overlay blocks) are positioned symmetrically on the left and right sides at three vertical levels, some with lighter gray trailing segments. A small dark irregular shape appears near the center just below and right of the crosshair intersection. A white timestamp is printed in the lower-left corner reading a date and time.
